target.title: fix(ollama): bound model pull body reads past idle timeout
target.body:
﻿## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where OpenClaw Ollama setup could hang forever while downloading a model when `/api/pull` kept sending occasional NDJSON progress lines that never advanced useful work. A slow drip resets the per-chunk idle timer on every chunk, so the existing 300s byte-idle budget never fires.

Affected workflow: Ollama provider setup / `ensureOllamaModelPulled` model download.

## Why This Change Was Made

Ollama setup already aborts if headers never arrive (30s) and already fails if the pull stream goes fully idle (300s). After headers return, the response timer is cleared, so only the per-chunk idle timer remains. Idle resets on every chunk, so a slow drip can keep the download alive indefinitely.

This keeps the headers and byte-idle budgets as-is, then arms a **no-progress watchdog** after the first body chunk. Liveness follows the documented Ollama `/api/pull` StatusEvent contract:

- a **changing** `status` renews the watchdog (status-only compatible producers stay supported)
- aggregate `completed` growth also renews (byte progress)
- **identical** status keepalive without completed growth fails closed (hang floor for stuck drips)
- forever-changing status-only drips are bounded by an absolute **max duration** (default 6h; test-overridable)

Layer progress is keyed by `digest` when present so multi-layer pulls do not overwrite under one status string.

Optional `streamNoProgressTimeoutMs` / `streamIdleTimeoutMs` / `streamMaxDurationMs` on `ensureOllamaModelPulled` are for tests only.

Collision check: searched open and closed PRs for `ollama pull stream watchdog`, `ollama pull no-progress`, `ollama setup pull`; no same-file or same-problem open PR was found. The closest closed PR (#99585) bounds native streaming body size, not progress.

## User Impact

During Ollama setup:

- stuck identical-status drips fail with a no-progress error
- healthy / compatible streams that keep changing `status` or advancing `completed` continue
- forever-changing adversarial drips fail at the absolute max duration instead of hanging setup forever

## Evidence

Exact head: `e10932b516ba006acf455d4d4f82e145e74a6cab`

`oxfmt` on touched files — passed.
`git diff --check` — clean.

### Tests

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  extensions/ollama/src/setup.pull-deadline.loopback.test.ts \
  extensions/ollama/src/setup.pull.test.ts \
  -- --run --reporter=verbose
```

```
Test Files  2 passed (2)
     Tests  13 passed (13)
```

### Real behavior proof

- Behavior or issue addressed: Ollama setup `/api/pull` no longer hangs on identical-status drips, while documented status-only streams that keep changing `status` remain compatible past the no-progress window; forever-changing drips hit absolute max duration.
- Real environment tested: Windows 10 + Node local checkout at `e10932b516ba006acf455d4d4f82e145e74a6cab` in worktree `openclaw-109155`.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:
  ```bash
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/ollama/src/setup.pull-deadline.loopback.test.ts extensions/ollama/src/setup.pull.test.ts -- --run --reporter=verbose
  ```
- Evidence after fix:
  ```text
  ✓ aborts a non-advancing identical-status drip within the no-progress timeout 340ms
  ✓ allows a continuing status-only stream past the no-progress window 639ms
  ✓ allows cycling status-only phases that finish with success 537ms
  ✓ bounds forever-changing status drips with absolute max duration 379ms (exceeded max duration)
  ✓ allows advancing completed progress past the shortened no-progress timeout 704ms
  Test Files  2 passed (2)
       Tests  13 passed (13)
  ```
- Observed result after fix: Production `ensureOllamaModelPulled` against real `node:http` loopback + real `fetch` rejects identical-status keepalive, completes continuing/cycling status-only streams that finish with `success`, and bounds forever-changing drips via max duration.
- What was not tested: Live pull against a real remote Ollama registry / large multi-GB model download over the public network.

Loopback server sources: `extensions/ollama/src/setup.pull-deadline.loopback.test.ts` — real `node:http`, real `fetch`, real `ReadableStream` consumer inside `pullOllamaModelCore`.
